epaMethods.title: CIOB online test
epaMethods.toleranceRule: 20 questions: 15 on health, safety and welfare obligations and 5 on project risk. 40-minute invigilated closed-book test. It must be passed before the project is submitted. Pass/Fail only.
epaMethods.timing: First; ideally month 1 after Gateway
epaMethods.resitRule: If an attempt is unsuccessful, follow the applicable assessment plan and the named EPAO’s formal resit/retake instructions; timelines are not automatic guarantees.
epaMethods.sourceSnippet: Governing current Skills England ST0044/AP01 assessment plan (link from standard page): https://skillsengland.education.gov.uk/media/3448/st0044_design-and-construction-management-degree-_l6-_ap_for_publication_13092019.pdf

epaMethods.title: Design & construction project
epaMethods.toleranceRule: Project subject, title and scope, including a 500-word synopsis, must be agreed at Gateway. Post-Gateway project submitted within a maximum of four months of EPA start; 3,000-word report (±10%).
epaMethods.timing: After test passed; submit by end of month 4
epaMethods.resitRule: If an attempt is unsuccessful, follow the applicable assessment plan and the named EPAO’s formal resit/retake instructions; timelines are not automatic guarantees.
epaMethods.sourceSnippet: Governing current Skills England ST0044/AP01 assessment plan (link from standard page): https://skillsengland.education.gov.uk/media/3448/st0044_design-and-construction-management-degree-_l6-_ap_for_publication_13092019.pdf

epaMethods.title: Professional discussion
epaMethods.wordCountSpec: Separate 2,700-word Summary of Experience (±10%) underpins discussion
epaMethods.toleranceRule: Prepare a separate 2,700-word Summary of Experience (±10%) from portfolio evidence; the independent assessor receives it at least two weeks before the discussion. Discussion is ideally taken by the end of month 5.
epaMethods.timing: After project passed; ideally by end of month 5
epaMethods.resitRule: If an attempt is unsuccessful, follow the applicable assessment plan and the named EPAO’s formal resit/retake instructions; timelines are not automatic guarantees.
epaMethods.sourceSnippet: Governing current Skills England ST0044/AP01 assessment plan (link from standard page): https://skillsengland.education.gov.uk/media/3448/st0044_design-and-construction-management-degree-_l6-_ap_for_publication_13092019.pdf

timelineSteps.title: Prepare evidence and eligibility
timelineSteps.summary: Confirm qualifications, any prescribed certificates and the employer-authenticated portfolio.
timelineSteps.tips: Check cohort-specific English/maths eligibility.

timelineSteps.title: Employer decision and CIOB verification
timelineSteps.summary: Employer confirms occupational competence, and apprenticeship/Gateway evidence is confirmed. Project subject, title and scope must be agreed with CIOB, including 500-word synopsis, project timeline and intended report submission date.
timelineSteps.tips: The 500-word scope and timeline are a Gateway requirement; do not move to month 2.

timelineSteps.title: Online knowledge test
timelineSteps.summary: Pass the 20-question, 40-minute, closed-book online test before progressing to the project.
timelineSteps.tips: Pass the test before proceeding where required by AP01.

timelineSteps.title: Work-based project
timelineSteps.summary: Submit the 3,000-word (±10%) work-based project after passing the online test. The project scope was agreed at Gateway.
timelineSteps.tips: Project has a typical three-month duration. Maintain employer-authenticated evidence.

timelineSteps.title: Professional discussion
timelineSteps.summary: Following a passed project, complete the professional discussion; a separate 2,700-word Summary of Experience (±10%) is submitted in advance.
timelineSteps.tips: CIOB should provide assessor with the Summary of Experience at least two weeks before professional discussion.

timelineSteps.title: Outcomes and further assessment
timelineSteps.summary: CIOB moderates and confirms outcomes. Any resit/retake follows the assessment plan and may require time within the typically six-month period.
timelineSteps.tips: Month 6 is a potential resit/retake period, not a guaranteed additional attempt or slot.

ST0044.overviewText: This page concerns Gateway and EPA requirements. Coventry University uses CIOB as its named EPAO for this standard. Check the start-date version before using this information for an individual learner. The currently linked Skills England ST0044/AP01 sets a typically six-month EPA and sequential test, project and professional discussion. Different historical-cohort EPA plans may need individual confirmation.
ST0044.reassessmentCaution: Any resit or retake is governed by the applicable EPA assessment plan and CIOB/RICS appointment arrangements; a displayed month is not a guaranteed slot.
ST0044.professionalCaution: The currently linked ST0044/AP01 plan sets typically six months for EPA, with test ideally month 1, project by month 4 and discussion ideally by month 5; verify historical cohort applicability.
ST0044.equalWeightingNote: Under the assessment plan linked from the current Skills England ST0044 page, three methods are equally weighted; online test is Pass/Fail. Project and professional discussion can achieve distinction. No 20/40/40 percentage weighting.

epaMethods.resitRule: If an attempt is unsuccessful, follow the applicable assessment plan and the named EPAO’s formal resit/retake instructions; timelines are not automatic guarantees.

timelineSteps.title: Prepare evidence and eligibility
timelineSteps.summary: Confirm qualifications, any prescribed certificates and the employer-authenticated portfolio.
timelineSteps.tips: Check cohort-specific English/maths eligibility.

timelineSteps.title: Employer decision and CIOB verification
timelineSteps.summary: Agree the project title and scope as required; submit the specified evidence to CIOB.
timelineSteps.tips: University progress review is not a replacement for employer readiness decision.

timelineSteps.title: Online knowledge test
timelineSteps.summary: Complete the applicable 20-question CIOB test and follow the prescribed sequence.
timelineSteps.tips: Pass the test before proceeding where required by AP01.

timelineSteps.title: Work-based project
timelineSteps.summary: Carry out and submit the specified project report to the CIOB timetable.
timelineSteps.tips: Follow the plan-specific word count and deadline.

timelineSteps.title: Professional discussion
timelineSteps.summary: Submit the separate Summary of Experience where prescribed, and undertake the assessor discussion.
timelineSteps.tips: Use authenticated evidence and relevant KSB mapping.

timelineSteps.title: Outcomes and resit/retake
timelineSteps.summary: CIOB confirms results and instructions for any reassessment; membership applications are separate.
timelineSteps.tips: Do not assume spare months guarantee a resit date.

gatewayRequirements.title: RICS candidate enrolment and qualified counsellor
gatewayRequirements.detail: RICS registration as apprentice candidate is required at commencement; a nominated MRICS/FRICS counsellor must have completed RICS counsellor training.
gatewayRequirements.sourceSnippet: Source: https://skillsengland.education.gov.uk/media/zn3fxgko/st0331-epa-plan-for-chartered-surveyor-dispensation-clean-copy_140526.pdf — consult the applicable plan/handbook and start-cohort rules.

gatewayRequirements.title: 24-month diary and 400 days of experience
gatewayRequirements.detail: Record at least 24 months of structured experience and at least 400 days of workplace experience in the RICS assessment records.

gatewayRequirements.title: 96 hours of CPD across final two years
gatewayRequirements.detail: Minimum 48 hours of CPD per annum over the preceding two-year period. Apply current RICS formal/informal proportions to the record.

gatewayRequirements.title: APC Counsellor declaration
gatewayRequirements.detail: The counsellor must be satisfied that the minimum number and level of APC competencies has been achieved; employer and counsellor declarations have separate functions.

epaMethods.title: RICS online professional-practice MCQ
epaMethods.format: 20 closed-response questions, OPEN BOOK; controlled environment
epaMethods.toleranceRule: The amended May 2026 AP03 supersedes outdated closed-book wording. Follow RICS assessment platform instructions.
epaMethods.timing: First assessment after Gateway; must pass before remaining methods
epaMethods.resitRule: If an attempt is unsuccessful, follow the applicable assessment plan and the named EPAO’s formal resit/retake instructions; timelines are not automatic guarantees.

epaMethods.title: RICS APC case study, presentation and questions
epaMethods.toleranceRule: Conclusion includes reflection, lessons learnt and what would be done differently; submission must be apprentice authored.
epaMethods.timing: RICS scheduled submission window
epaMethods.resitRule: If an attempt is unsuccessful, follow the applicable assessment plan and the named EPAO’s formal resit/retake instructions; timelines are not automatic guarantees.

epaMethods.title: RICS APC Summary of Experience and final interview
epaMethods.durationOrLength: 60-minute interview overall (includes case-study presentation and questioning)
epaMethods.toleranceRule: 3-person panel in amended AP03; 10m presentation, 10m case questioning and 40m competency questioning.
epaMethods.timing: RICS scheduled final-assessment window
epaMethods.resitRule: If an attempt is unsuccessful, follow the applicable assessment plan and the named EPAO’s formal resit/retake instructions; timelines are not automatic guarantees.

timelineSteps.title: RICS registration, diary and CPD
timelineSteps.summary: Prepare the RICS-accredited award, at least 24 months of diary, 400 experience days and 96 CPD hours over two years.
timelineSteps.tips: Seek counsellor reviews; registration required at apprenticeship commencement.

timelineSteps.title: Employer and counsellor readiness
timelineSteps.summary: Employer confirms occupational competence; qualified RICS counsellor confirms APC competency readiness. The provider submits the necessary evidence.
timelineSteps.tips: Confirm the RICS session Gateway deadline, not only an internal date.

timelineSteps.title: RICS professional-practice MCQ
timelineSteps.summary: Complete and pass the open-book RICS online assessment before proceeding to the other components.
timelineSteps.tips: RICS rules and assessment platform govern administration.

timelineSteps.title: Submit APC materials
timelineSteps.summary: Submit the case study, Summary of Experience and required declarations within the RICS assessment window.
timelineSteps.tips: Actual dates vary by Land & Property or Built Environment group.

timelineSteps.title: Final APC assessment
timelineSteps.summary: Present the case study and answer case and professional-competence questions during the panel interview.
timelineSteps.tips: Follow official interview notice and current RICS guidance.

timelineSteps.title: Results, referrals and recognition
timelineSteps.summary: RICS confirms outcomes; if referred, review the official referral report and appropriate next assessment window.
timelineSteps.tips: The apprenticeship certificate and professional-registration administration may follow separate timelines.
